stage0031b_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So we just intercept when it makes its move.」

stage0031b_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$リツコ$$
「But sooner or later, it'll notice the EVA...
　How long we can delay that
　depends on how hard $c works.」

stage0031b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You look pretty exhausted.
　Looks like you were watching $c's unit, though.」

stage0031b_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$リツコ$$
「$$シンジ$$'s friend asked me to.」

stage0031b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Relax your shoulders.
　It's not your turn yet.」

stage0031b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アマタ$$
「If it gets too close,
　I'll knock it down with Aquarion's Mugen Attack.」

stage0031b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Aquarion has the Mugen Attack, fine,
　but why is $$ジェニオン$$ on escort duty?」

stage0031b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「By calculation, $$ジェニオン$$'s D-Fault at max output
　could deflect a bit of
　that Angel's beam, apparently.」

stage0031b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Worried about $$ミコノ$$, since she's off the roster?」

stage0031b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「This fight's going to be right on the edge.
　$$ミコノ$$ can't handle it.」

stage0031b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$アマタ$$
（$$ミコノ$$... she'll get down about it again...）

stage0031b_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$...
　Just getting in the EVA is enough for me
　to be grateful. Thank you.」

stage0031b_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Operation Yashima, go...!
　Prep the Positron Cannon, begin first connection!」

stage0031b_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$マコト$$
「Roger.
　Switching all primary and secondary substations!」

stage0031b_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Roger...!
　All units, keep moving, pin the Angel down!」

stage0031b_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Don't push it!
　One direct hit from its beam and you're done!」

stage0031b_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　We'll hold that diamond thing off!」

stage0031b_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Once the charge is done,
　don't hold back, let it rip!」

stage0031b_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$アマタ$$, $$レイ#333$$, $n!
　Watch over $$シンジ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on!
　I'll knock that bastard down in those 4 minutes!」

stage0031b_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$シモン$$
「But $$シンジ$$!
　If it comes to it, I'm counting on you!」

stage0031b_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Positron Cannon, fourth connection, no problems!」

stage0031b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I don't have Ayanami's resolve...
　I'm not even confident I can pilot the EVA well...）

stage0031b_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I don't even know why. I just somehow made it move.
　Protect humanity...?
　Something this big feels unreal... why me...?）

stage0031b_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「No good!
　As long as the core's intact, it'll regenerate!」

stage0031b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Positron Cannon, fourth connection, no problems!」

stage0031b_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I don't have Ayanami's resolve...
　I'm not even confident I can pilot the EVA well...）

stage0031b_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I don't even know why. I just somehow made it move.
　Protect humanity...?
　Something this big feels unreal... why me...?）

stage0031b_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Was it that attack on the EVA just now!?」

stage0031b_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$n
「Damn it!
　Unit-01 got hit while we were right there...!」

stage0031b_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Where the hell did that attack come from!?」

stage0031b_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シゲル$$
「Unidentified units incoming from the area!」

stage0031b_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ジン$$
「Seeing the Mechanical Angel so frustrated,
　I guess our timing was pretty good.」

stage0031b_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ジン$$
（Still, that guy gives me the creeps...
　Why's $$ミカゲ$$ so fixated on someone like that...）

stage0031b_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$甲児$$
「The operation itself didn't fail!
　Let's hit those Abductors!」

stage0031b_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$さやか$$
「Wait, $$甲児$$!
　Something else is coming!」

stage0031b_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$タケル$$
「Does he seriously not care if the world ends!?」

stage0031b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シモン$$
「The EVA's still alive!
　We fight to the very end!」

stage0031b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Still intact!
　Currently cooling the barrel!」

stage0031b_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Then we just do it!
　...$$シンジ$$, are you okay!?」

stage0031b_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Effective immediately, relieve the Unit-01 pilot.
　Have the Unit-00 pilot take over as sniper.」

stage0031b_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「If it can't be used, it has to be cut loose.」

stage0031b_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Please wait!
　He got into the EVA without running!
　Unless he chooses to step down, trust him with it!」

stage0031b_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$葵$$
「Get up, $$シンジ$$!
　We haven't lost yet!」

stage0031b_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アルト$$
「Is this really where you end!?
　Was everything we fought together for nothing!?」

stage0031b_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do not whine, $$シンジ$$...!
　You are our comrade in arms!」

stage0031b_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　You're fighting with us too!!」

stage0031b_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$c believed in him too,
　that's why they joined this dangerous mission!」

stage0031b_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Please believe in your own child!」

stage0031b_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...Very well.
　Do as you like.」

stage0031b_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$n, $$アマタ$$!
　Get out there too!
　This is an all out fight now!!」

stage0031b_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$レイ#333$$!
　Please look after $$シンジ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You heard that, everyone!
　Just four more minutes, protect $$シンジ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Please, everyone!
　Just give me a little more time!!」

stage0031b_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$シモン$$
「So now it's your turn to believe in us!」

stage0031b_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$n
「I know!
　I'm a member of $c too!」

stage0031b_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Ignore the Angel!
　A fight breaking out nearby will tie it down regardless!」

stage0031b_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Target the Abductors and Beasts blocking the op!
　$c, begin the attack!」

stage0031b_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シゲル$$
「All obstacles are clear except $$第６の使徒$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ジン$$
「I won't let you have it your way.」

stage0031b_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let you interfere with $$シンジ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Dodge!
　You're right in that shiny thing's line of fire!」

stage0031b_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$モロイ$$
「When did we end up on the Quarter?!」

stage0031b_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　$$ユノハ・スルール$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「The legendary vanishing transfer student!」

stage0031b_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アンディ$$
「The vanishing transfer student, for real!
　I can't believe she actually exists!」

stage0031b_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No... If you stare at me like that, I'll...!」

stage0031b_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$不動$$
「Bashfulness amplifies her power,
　becoming perfect optical transparency...
　This is $$ユノハ・スルール$$'s Element ability.」

stage0031b_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$不動$$
「A graceful, modest feat, born of a maiden's heart...」

stage0031b_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ジン$$
「So, the power of the Mechanical Angel's $$レア・イグラー$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Now we counterattack!
　We'll take down that Abductor ourselves!」

stage0031b_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$不動$$
「Next, Element Change!
　$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$, $$ゼシカ・ウォン$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What's gotten into you, $$ミコノ$$!
　You're all fired up!」

stage0031b_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$シンジ$$'s working so hard too...!
　So am I!」

stage0031b_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I can feel $$ミコノ$$'s feelings coming through...!」

stage0031b_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Not just $$ミコノ$$!
　I can feel $$アマタ$$'s feelings too!」

stage0031b_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$不動$$
「In a fight this dire, pretense is useless.
　Cast it all off, and bare your true self.」

stage0031b_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「B-bare my true self... he says...」

stage0031b_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「W-what are you doing, $$ゼシカ$$!
　Why are you tearing your own clothes?!」

stage0031b_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm baring myself!
　You should do it too, $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「T-that's... there's no way I could do that!」

stage0031b_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This isn't the time to be shy!
　Even $$ユノハ$$ pushed through her embarrassment!」

stage0031b_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ミコノ$$!
　Is that seriously the best you've got?!
　$$アマタ$$'s gonna be disappointed at this rate!」

stage0031b_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let $$ミコノ$$ be the only one embarrassed!」

stage0031b_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ジン$$
「W-what?!
　What are you doing, Mechanical Angel!」

stage0031b_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Is this really alright, Supreme Commander?」

stage0031b_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$不動$$
「Baring one's skin sharpens the senses...
　In exchange for torn clothes and vulnerability,
　one becomes acutely responsive to enemy attacks.」

stage0031b_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シュレード$$
「What a mad rhapsody.
　I could never play a tune like that...」

stage0031b_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What is this spirit level?!
　A value we've never seen before!」

stage0031b_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$不動$$
「That fierce clash of shame and release!
　Let your skin burn, and cut through the flesh!」

stage0031b_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ジン$$
「Game over...
　Beaten by such a reckless tactic...!」

stage0031b_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We did it, $$アマタ$$, $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$シゲル$$
「High energy reading from the Angel too!」

stage0031b_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$リツコ$$
「It's going to exchange fire with Unit-01?!」

stage0031b_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$宗介$$
「No good!
　The shot's slightly off the core!!」

stage0031b_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Hurry!
　The Angel's already begun regenerating!」

stage0031b_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$マヤ$$
「The Angel's position shifted from that last hit!
　Recalculating the targeting will take time!」

stage0031b_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And we're almost out of energy, too!」

stage0031b_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
Zero
「I refuse to accept the end of the world!
　I'll calculate the targeting myself, in $$蜃気楼$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... got lonely, so you came out?」

stage0031b_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Seems that man had a hand in this operation.」

stage0031b_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Now it all connects!
　Having us play bullet shields on the front lines,
　that was probably that bastard's idea!」

stage0031b_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We're out of energy to fire the positron cannon...!」

stage0031b_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If we pool each unit's remaining energy,
　we should manage at least one shot!」

stage0031b_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$リツコ$$
「$c made the request.
　In case something happened, they wanted connectors
　ready to feed each unit's power to the cannon.」

stage0031b_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「With this, we can do it...!」

stage0031b_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$シン$$
「What are you saying, after coming this far?!」

stage0031b_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
Zero
「I can't clear the geomagnetic interference!
　With the Angel where it is, hitting the core dead-on
　means I have to bend the positron cannon's arc!」

stage0031b_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$タケル$$
「What are you trying to do, $n!?」

stage0031b_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$n
「You, in the black unit!
　Sending you $$ジェニオン$$'s D-Fault data!」

stage0031b_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「D-Fault...!
　I see, that could work!」

stage0031b_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Bending the positron cannon's path with $$ジェニオン$$!?」

stage0031b_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$n
「I'll evacuate at the very last second too!」

stage0031b_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's not it, $n!
　Are you all right with losing $$ジェニオン$$!?」

stage0031b_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「If that happens, your fight would...」

stage0031b_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$n
「$$シンジ$$, $$レイ#333$$, Aquarion, everyone...
　they're all staking their lives on this!」

stage0031b_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$n
「There's nothing more important
　than this very moment!」

stage0031b_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$n
「Hurry with the calculations!
　There's no time left!」

stage0031b_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Understood, $n!
　But I'm seeing this through with you to the end!」

stage0031b_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「All calculations are complete!
　Sending the data to the positron cannon!」

stage0031b_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$n
「I'm fine, $$宗介$$.
　I'm not planning on dying just yet.」

stage0031b_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アルト$$
「What are you doing, after coming this far!」

stage0031b_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$シンジ$$
「B-but...!
　I've already failed twice as it is!」

stage0031b_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even so, we believe in you!」

stage0031b_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Even those two times, you gave it your all!
　You overcame your fear!」

stage0031b_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's why we believe in you!
　Go, $$シンジ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$赤木$$
「Hang in there, $$シンジ$$!
　Third time's the charm!」

stage0031b_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$シモン$$
「Show us the fight we believed in you for!!」

stage0031b_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　Our wish... humanity's future... every surviving life,
　we entrust it all to you!」

stage0031b_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's all right.
　Looks like they just passed out.」

stage0031b_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Because that system activated,
　$$ジェニオン$$ was able to withstand the positron cannon...」

stage0031b_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Well done, $$碇シンジ$$...
　I'm sure you'll be able to find
　your own fight...）

stage0031b_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Such an unsociable man.
　He could just enjoy the victory honestly.」

stage0031b_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the enemy's withdrawn too...」

stage0031b_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$オットー$$
「Honestly, that saved us...!
　We were already running on empty.」

stage0031b_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「A battle where we gave everything...
　That's exactly why we've won.」

stage0031b_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It's informal, but I'm issuing your promotion.
　Keep up the good work.」

stage0031b_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The 12,000-year cycle is about to close...
　The battles ahead will grow even harsher.」

stage0031b_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Well then, I wish you good luck.」

stage0031b_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$冬月$$
（Today's battle turned it into certainty.）

stage0031b_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
（12,000 years... no, an even longer cycle
　of time ends here, at the edge of myth...）

stage0031b_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$冬月$$
（Is it coincidence these pieces are aligning...?）

stage0031b_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
（Either way, I'll need to pay
　that man a visit sometime.）

stage0031b_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$シゲル$$
「Energy reading detected from the Angel!」

stage0031b_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$シゲル$$
「It's not that high-energy a reading, but...」

stage0031b_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So it lowered output to fire in rapid bursts!」

stage0031b_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$リツコ$$
「But this lowers the chance of EVA
　being sniped.」

stage0031b_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But this means putting $c
　in danger...!」

stage0031b_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$リツコ$$
「You approved your mystery boyfriend's plan.
　It's too late to call it off now.」

stage0031b_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Sorry, everyone...
　I know it's asking a lot, but I believe
　you'll all come through for me...）

stage0031b_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, keep it up!
　As long as we keep this thing pinned,
　it makes $$シンジ$$'s job that much easier!」

stage0031b_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$葵$$
「What are you talking about, Major $$オズマ$$!
　We're planning to steal $$シンジ$$'s job!」

stage0031b_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I like that!
　Sorry to NERV for prepping that secret weapon,
　but we're doing this anyway!」

stage0031b_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's how it is, $$シンジ$$!
　Sorry, but there's no turn for you today!」

stage0031b_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Even so, that speed's way too fast!」

stage0031b_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Leave the Angel to EVA!
　We'll take out the enemies around it!」

stage0031b_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...So the operation's a failure...」

stage0031b_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ジン$$
「I already accounted for something like this.」

stage0031b_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Like we'd let him go!
　We're cornering him right here!」

stage0031b_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let you interfere with $$シンジ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Dodge!
　You're right in that shiny thing's line of fire!」

stage0031b_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$モロイ$$
「When did we end up on the Quarter?!」

stage0031b_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　$$ユノハ・スルール$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「The legendary vanishing transfer student!」

stage0031b_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$アンディ$$
「The vanishing transfer student, for real!
　I can't believe she actually exists!」

stage0031b_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No... If you stare at me like that, I'll...!」

stage0031b_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$不動$$
「Bashfulness amplifies her power,
　becoming perfect optical transparency...
　This is $$ユノハ・スルール$$'s Element ability.」

stage0031b_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$不動$$
「A graceful, modest feat, born of a maiden's heart...」

stage0031b_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$ジン$$
「So, the power of the Mechanical Angel's $$レア・イグラー$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Now we counterattack!
　We'll take down that Abductor ourselves!」

stage0031b_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$不動$$
「Next, Element Change!
　$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$, $$ゼシカ・ウォン$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What's gotten into you, $$ミコノ$$!
　You're all fired up!」

stage0031b_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$シンジ$$'s working so hard too...!
　So am I!」

stage0031b_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I can feel $$ミコノ$$'s feelings coming through...!」

stage0031b_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Not just $$ミコノ$$!
　I can feel $$アマタ$$'s feelings too!」

stage0031b_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$不動$$
「In a fight this dire, pretense is useless.
　Cast it all off, and bare your true self.」

stage0031b_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$アマタ$$
「B-bare my true self... he says...」

stage0031b_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「W-what are you doing, $$ゼシカ$$!
　Why are you tearing your own clothes?!」

stage0031b_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm baring myself!
　You should do it too, $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「T-that's... there's no way I could do that!」

stage0031b_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This isn't the time to be shy!
　Even $$ユノハ$$ pushed through her embarrassment!」

stage0031b_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ミコノ$$!
　Is that seriously the best you've got?!
　$$アマタ$$'s gonna be disappointed at this rate!」

stage0031b_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let $$ミコノ$$ be the only one embarrassed!」

stage0031b_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$ジン$$
「W-what?!
　What are you doing, Mechanical Angel!」

stage0031b_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Is this really alright, Supreme Commander?」

stage0031b_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$不動$$
「Baring one's skin sharpens the senses...
　In exchange for torn clothes and vulnerability,
　one becomes acutely responsive to enemy attacks.」

stage0031b_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$シュレード$$
「What a mad rhapsody.
　I could never play a tune like that...」

stage0031b_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What is this spirit level?!
　A value we've never seen before!」

stage0031b_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$不動$$
「That fierce clash of shame and release!
　Let your skin burn, and cut through the flesh!」

stage0031b_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$ジン$$
「Game over...
　Beaten by such a reckless tactic...!」

stage0031b_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We did it, $$アマタ$$, $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's thanks to $$ミコノ$$'s strength too,
　that we were able to beat him」

stage0031b_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「That's right!
　$$ミコノ$$'s an Element too, you know!」

stage0031b_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Alright...!
　Let's keep protecting $$シンジ$$ and fight!」

stage0031b_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here we go, you shiny kaiju!
　Since $$シンジ$$'s giving it his all,
　I'll go all out too!」

stage0031b_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$!
　Until the charge finishes,
　we're protecting $$シンジ$$ no matter what!」

stage0031b_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　Leave the front line to us!」

stage0031b_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$アルト$$
「We'll set the perfect stage
　for your sniping, count on it!」

stage0031b_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If it's alive, I'll kill it,
　if it's a machine, I'll smash it, that's how I fight!」

stage0031b_04:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$シンジ$$ doesn't even need to step in!
　I'll beat you down myself!」

stage0031b_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$シンジ$$!
　You're not fighting alone!」

stage0031b_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$甲児$$
「We're fighting alongside you too!
　So we're counting on you for the finishing blow!」

stage0031b_04:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't lose, $$シンジ$$!
　We've got your back!」

stage0031b_04:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$赤木$$
「We'll hold this thing down,
　so the finish is up to you!」

stage0031b_04:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$カレン$$
「I swear I'll protect $$シンジ$$!
　So...!」

stage0031b_04:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$カレン$$
「Come on, $$シンジ$$!
　We've bet everything on you!」

stage0031b_04:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$シンジ$$...
　We will stake our lives for you.」

stage0031b_04:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$宗介$$
「Therefore, you
　will meet our expectations...!」

stage0031b_04:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$シモン$$
「I've handled faceless bastards before, riding $$ムガン$$!」

stage0031b_04:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$シモン$$
「No matter how amazing a barrier you've got,
　don't you dare think you can stop
　me and $$グレンラガン$$'s drill!!」

stage0031b_04:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$シンジ$$ is overcoming his fear,
　just to pilot EVA...!」

stage0031b_04:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「All we can do is fight with everything we've got,
　and send him our courage!」

stage0031b_04:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$n
「I'm counting on you, $$シンジ$$!
　You're the key to today's mission!」

stage0031b_04:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$n
「Overcome your fear!
　I won't let you say you can't after cheering me on!」

stage0031b_04:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$ジン$$
「Now then... let me return the favor from before,
　Mechanical Angel.」

stage0031b_04:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Somehow, this enemy's hard to pin down...!」

stage0031b_04:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$ジン$$
「Fufufu... I've already got your data.
　Whether you use that arm-stretching punch,
　or shift forms, you're no match for me now」

stage0031b_04:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$ジン$$
「Following $$ミカゲ$$'s orders,
　I tried targeting this one, but...」

stage0031b_04:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$ジン$$
「This machine... up close, it looks even more vicious.
　Like an ogre, or a demon.」

stage0031b_04:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$ジン$$
「I wonder what kind of savage
　pilots something like this.」

stage0031b_04:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Watch me, $$シンジ$$...!
　I'll fight too, with the courage you gave me!）

stage0031b_04:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（And I believe in you too...!
　That you'll surely pull through...!）

stage0031b_04:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's go, $$ユノハ$$!
　You're an Element too!」

stage0031b_04:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
（This is embarrassing...
　But I can't run away... I mustn't run away...）

stage0031b_04:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$ユノハ$$
（$$シンジ$$'s trying his best too...!
　So I've decided to try my best too!）

stage0031b_04:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$葵$$
「$$シンジ$$...!
　We're risking our lives too, same as you!」

stage0031b_04:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$葵$$
「We're giving it everything we've got too!
　So you'd better give it your all too!!」
